# js-table

> Browser virtual data grid/table with row virtualization, local querying, chunked loading, selection, local editing, clipboard copy, and a thin React wrapper.

## Start here

- [Agent guide](./AGENTS.md)
- [API reference](./docs/api.md)
- [Architecture](./docs/architecture.md)
- [Cookbook](./docs/cookbook.md)
- [React wrapper](./react/README.md)
- [Single-file agent summary](./llms-full.txt)

## Important constraints

- Global browser API: `window.VirtualGridTable`
- React wrapper: `./react`
- Constructor takes a container **id string**
- No TypeScript support currently
- No npm package currently; the core `/app.js` class is still exposed as a browser global
- Row virtualization only
- Chunked mode expects the provider to apply search/sort/filter state
